title: Require Domain Router Aggregate Shape
forbids: domain router files exposing helpers, implementations, constituent module routers, or any authority besides their singular default createDomainRouter result
why: A domain router is the executable aggregate over its declared module contracts. Keeping runtime composition to one local contract plus direct module routers preserves the contract/runtime phase boundary and prevents alternate execution surfaces.
remediate: Import createDomainRouter from @swooper/mapgen-core/authoring, the local ./contract.js default, and each direct module router from ./modules/<module>/router.js; bind them once and default-export only that router.
message: Domain router.ts must expose one default aggregate runtime authority only.
